title: The work of becoming
introduction: For anyone building something slowly, one ordinary day at a time.
lines:
No trumpet marks the morning
you decide to try again.
Only the chair pulled closer,
the page turned,
the sleeves rolled back.

The world may not yet notice,
but the work does.
Every patient hour
is teaching your hands
the shape of becoming.

title: The light knows where to find us
introduction: A few lines about hope arriving quietly on an ordinary afternoon.
lines:
Leave the curtain open—
not for the grand sunrise,
but for the small gold square
that crosses the floor at four.

Even the light
takes the long way home.

title: Small beginnings
introduction: A reminder that meaningful things often begin almost invisibly.
lines:
A seed does not apologise
for being smaller than the tree.
It gathers the dark,
drinks what rain it can,
and begins.

May we be brave enough
to begin that quietly.
